principle: Current lake geometry is defined by Sentinel 2024-2026, not by the AMSCLAE bathymetry footprint. AMSCLAE NoData must never be interpreted as land.

current_lake_definition.meaning: Sentinel modern reference mask at 50 percent water occurrence for 2024-2026.

shore_corridor.meaning: Sentinel 20-80 percent modern littoral transition band.

classes.3: Sentinel 20-80 littoral band with AMSCLAE coverage
classes.4: Sentinel 20-80 littoral band without AMSCLAE coverage

next_step: 16B4b: build the shoreline-oscillation surface only where current Sentinel water lacks AMSCLAE bathymetry, without requiring vertical continuity with the AMSCLAE edge.
